tool_arguments.prompt:
Create ONE completely fresh hand-painted production pose drawing, using the attached adopted proboscis-monkey neutral only as the exact identity/style/proportion reference. Genuine transparent RGBA background, a single full character with all appendages and generous outer padding, large native 1254px square or larger. Keep the canonical giant rounded head occupying roughly HALF the full body height and the VERY SHORT squat round pear-shaped torso directly below the chin; same short thick feet. This is a slightly anthropomorphic cast character in a gentle watercolor picture-book world. Preserve the orange-brown fur, cream cheeks/chest/belly and inner tail, pink inner ears, two white oval eyes with brown pupils and no added highlights, long rounded pendulous nose, smile, short rounded paws and ONE curved tail on viewer right. Keep the head/shoulder/chin-to-groin proportions exactly like the reference. A prior small-sheet attempt was rejected for making the torso6%too long; do not slim, stretch or grow a neck, and do not move the giant head upward. Same warm thin-to-medium brown contour and soft paper texture contained within the painted silhouette. No clothes/hat, props, extra limbs, effect lines, captions, backdrop, floor or shadow.
POSE: Frontal compact torso, extend the other existing short forearm toward VIEWER RIGHT, rounded paw gesturing right and pupils looking right; keep the huge head at ordinary neutral height.
